data.one_liner: Fast Fourier Transform library supporting inputs of any size, with STFT and convolution tools.
data.what_it_does: Computes Fast Fourier Transforms (FFT) for real or complex arrays of any size, converting signals between the time domain and frequency domain. It also provides related utilities such as windowing functions, Short-Time Fourier Transform (STFT), inverse FFT, and convolution.
use_when: You need to filter or synthesize audio signals in your app.
You are computing a spectrogram for audio analysis or AI models.
You need custom audio filtering or convolution operations.
avoid_when: You do not need signal processing or frequency analysis in your application.
strengths: Supports FFT of any input size, not just powers of two.
Highly efficient implementation utilizing Float64x2List and SIMD optimizations.
Includes utilities for STFT, audio resampling, and windowing functions.
weaknesses: Requires manual array management and understanding of signal processing concepts.
